notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Ancient Adamantoise indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to yourself or a permanent you control.
description:
Give Ancient Adamantoise indestructible by any method.
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Ancient Adamantoise
Deal damage to yourself or a permanent you control, with that damage being redirected to Ancient Adamantoise
Arcbond triggers, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to Ancient Adamantoise to each other creature and each player, with all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control being dealt to Ancient Adamantoise instead.
Repeat from step 4.
